tos_sec1_p1: The ATG – All-Time Greats application (hereinafter: application) is developed and operated by the 404 not found studio. Contact: the.offical.404.not.found.team@gmail.com. By logging in, you accept these terms and the Privacy Policy.
tos_sec2_p1: The application also involves alcoholic beverages, therefore it is intended exclusively for users over 18 years of age. By logging in, you declare that you are over 18.
tos_sec3_p1: The application provides a shared space for groups of friends: tracking shared costs and debts, plans and a calendar, drink suggestions and tier lists, a group picture gallery, games and game rules, and “Days since” counters. The application is free and has no paid features. You can also ask for notifications about some features.
tos_sec4_p1: You alone, as the uploader, bear responsibility for uploaded images, texts, and other content. Uploading the following content is prohibited: illegal, rights-violating, harassing, or offensive content.
tos_zero_tolerance: Zero tolerance: uploading content depicting or promoting child sexual exploitation and abuse (CSAE/CSAM) is strictly prohibited. Such content results in immediate removal and account deletion.
tos_sec5_p1: If you violate the above rules, we will remove the infringing content and may suspend or delete your account. If you find infringing content, write to the above email address.
tos_sec6_p1: The application does not encourage alcohol consumption and does not provide medical advice. Content related to drinks is for informational purposes.
tos_sec7_p1: The Debts module is solely for informational record-keeping among users. The application does not perform financial transactions and assumes no responsibility for settlement disputes.
tos_sec8_p1: The application is provided by the operator on an "as-is" basis, without warranties. To the extent permitted by law, the operator assumes no liability for damages resulting from data loss, service interruptions, or errors.
tos_sec9_p1: We may modify these terms from time to time. You will be notified of material changes within the application, and modified terms will require new acceptance (versioned acceptance upon login).
tos_sec10_p1: Handling of your data is governed by the Privacy Policy. You can read about deleting your account on the Delete Account page.
del_intro: The ATG – All-Time Greats application is developed and operated by the 404 not found studio. The description below explains how you can delete your account and associated data.
del_sec1_step2: Click your profile picture in the top-right corner and choose Settings.
del_sec1_step3: Scroll to the bottom of Settings and press Delete account.
del_sec1_step4: Confirm deletion in the appearing modal window.
del_sec1_p1: Deletion is immediate and permanent: your profile linked to your Google account, your display name, and your group membership are deleted from the database. If you are the only member of your group, all group data (debts, plans, events, drinks/tier list, uploaded pictures) is also permanently deleted.
del_sec1_warning: If you are the administrator of your group and there are other members: before deleting your account, first transfer admin rights to another member in the Profile → Group Data menu, otherwise deletion will fail (the group would remain without an admin).
del_sec2_title: 2. Requesting Deletion If You Cannot Access the Application
del_sec2_p1: If for any reason you cannot log in (e.g. you deleted your Google account, or you cannot reach the app due to a technical error), you can request the deletion of your account and associated data via email:
del_sec2_step1: Send an email to the.offical.404.not.found.team@gmail.com address with the subject "Fiók törlése - ATG".
del_sec2_step2: Specify which Google account (email address) belongs to the profile to be deleted.
del_sec2_step3: We will process the request within 14 days and confirm the deletion via email.
del_sec3_p1: During deletion, we remove your profile linked to your Google account (display name), your group membership, and – if you were the last member – all data of your group, including uploaded pictures. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. You can also revoke ATG's access anytime in your Google Account under Third-party apps with account access.
del_questions: If you have any questions, write to the the.offical.404.not.found.team@gmail.com address.

tst_intro: ATG is coming to Google Play soon. For that, Google asks for a two-week closed test, and you can help. Thanks for being part of it!
tst_join_desc: Three steps, a few minutes in total. You need an Android phone.
tst_s1_d: Open the ATG tesztelők Google Group and tap Join. Sign in with the same Google account that the Play Store uses on your phone.
tst_ill_invite: As a tester you can try the unreleased version.
tst_s2_d: Open the invitation and tap Become a tester. It takes Google a few minutes to register it.
tst_s3_d: ATG then shows up in the Play Store. Install it and keep it for at least 14 days.
tst_iphone_note: Got an iPhone? The Play Store test only works on Android, but you can still install the browser app from the home page.
tst_tasks_title: What we ask during the 14 days
tst_tasks_desc: Open the app almost every day and do one or two things in it. A few minutes is enough. Some ideas:
tst_t1_d: to the calendar on the Home page, even a made-up one.
tst_t2_d: on the Plans page, or tick one off.
tst_t3_d: on the Tier list: drag it to another tier.
tst_t4_d: to the Pictures page, or browse the gallery.
tst_t5_d: and settle it. A test entry is fine.
tst_keep_note: Don’t uninstall it for 14 days! If you drop out of the test in the meantime, Google won’t count you.
tst_feedback_desc: Every bug, oddity or idea is gold. You can tell us in two ways:
tst_fb_play_d: As a tester you can send us private feedback on the ATG Store page. Only we see it; it is not a public review.
tst_fb_mail_d: Tell us what you did, what happened and what phone you have. A screenshot helps a lot.

pp_s1_p1: The ATG – All-Time Greats application (hereinafter: the application) is developed and operated by the 404 not found studio. For any question, comment or request about data protection, write to the.offical.404.not.found.team@gmail.com.
pp_s2_p1: When you sign in, we receive the following from your Google account (via OAuth):
pp_s2_li1: the name and email address of your Google account,
pp_s2_p2: For the group features we store the following data, created by you or your group members:
pp_s2_li3: group membership and role in the group (group admin or member),
pp_s2_li4: debts added to the group: the members’ names, the amount, the description, and who added it and when,
pp_s2_li5: plans and events, with who added them and when,
pp_s2_li6: drink suggestions and ratings (who suggested the drink and when),
pp_s2_li7: changes to the tier list: who put which drink in which place and when (visible to group members),
pp_s2_li8: pictures uploaded to the gallery, with who uploaded them and when,
pp_s2_li_hn: your “Days since” counters: what you count, when you last did it and your record; the names of counter templates you suggest, and who suggested them and when,
pp_s2_li9: submitted reports: who reported which content, when, for what reason, and any description,
pp_s2_li10: the time and version of your acceptance of the terms of use,
pp_s2_li11: a log of group join attempts (user ID and time), kept for 1 day,
pp_s2_li12: an activity log: who performed which action (create, update, delete), when, in which group and on which record — see section 7 for details,
pp_s2_li13: if you turn on notifications: the push subscription of that device (the address issued by your browser’s or phone’s notification service and the keys needed for encryption), the language at the time of subscribing, and the time of subscribing and of the last delivery. This is stored per device, linked to your account.
pp_s2_p3: In your browser (localStorage and the browser cache) we only store cached data, your theme and language settings, and whether we have already offered notifications; this includes a local copy of the group gallery pictures you have already viewed (at most 150 pictures), which is deleted when you sign out. None of this grants access: access is always decided by the server based on your sign-in.
pp_s3_title: 3. What we use the data for and on what legal basis
pp_s3_li1: Providing the service: running sign-in, groups, debts, plans, events, tier lists and the gallery. Legal basis: performance of a contract (using the application).
pp_s3_li2: Security and abuse prevention: for example, limiting join attempts. Legal basis: legitimate interest.
pp_s3_li3: Notifications: if you turn them on, we notify you when someone records a debt for you, adds a new event to the group calendar, when one of your “Days since” counters reaches a milestone (1, 2 and 4 weeks, 2 and 3 months), and when a counter template you suggested is approved; studio members (superadmins) are also notified about incoming reports and about drinks and counter templates awaiting approval. Legal basis: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time in the settings (Notifications); signing out also withdraws it on that device.
pp_s3_li4: Google Calendar sync: if you turn it on, we copy the group’s events (title, date, who added them) into a separate Google calendar and share that calendar with your Google account’s email address so you can see it in your own Google Calendar. Legal basis: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time in the settings (Google Calendar); we then revoke the sharing.
pp_s3_p1: We do not use the data for advertising or analytics, and we do not sell it.
pp_s4_li1: Google: sign-in (OAuth); if you turn on Google Calendar sync, Google Calendar also receives the group’s events and, for sharing, your email address.
pp_s4_li2: Supabase: database, authentication and file storage. Server region: eu-west-1, Ireland (EU).
pp_s4_li4: Google gstatic: the Google logo on the sign-in button is loaded from here, so it sees the visitor’s IP address when loading. All other libraries and icons are served from our own site.
pp_s4_li5: Notification services (depending on your browser or phone: Google Firebase Cloud Messaging, Apple Push Notification service or Mozilla Push Service): only if you turn on notifications. They deliver the notification to your device; they receive its content encrypted and cannot read it.
pp_s4_p1: There are no advertising or analytics providers.
pp_s5_p1: The database and file storage are in the European Union (Ireland). Our providers (for example Supabase, Google and the notification services) may also process data outside the EU during sign-in and operation. This is governed by their own privacy terms.
pp_s6_p1: We keep the data until the account or the group is deleted. The group join log is kept for 1 day. The notification subscription is kept until you turn off notifications, sign out or delete your account; if the notification service reports that the subscription has expired, we delete it automatically. The retention period of the activity log is set out in section 7.
pp_s7_p1: For security reasons and to investigate abuse and disputes, we log who performed which action and when (create, update, delete) on debts, plans, events, drink suggestions, group membership and gallery pictures, and in which group and on which record. A log entry contains only the essential data (e.g. the amount, the status), not the full record. Legal basis: legitimate interest.
pp_s7_p2: The log can be seen only by the studio (superadmins), not by users. Retention period: 1 year, after which entries are deleted automatically. When you delete your account, the “performed by” field is removed from the log (the rest of the entry may remain until the end of the retention period).
pp_s8_p1a: You can delete your account and data in the application: Profile → Settings → Delete account. If you cannot access it, you can also request deletion by email, and we process the request within 14 days. Details are on the
pp_s8_p1b: page. The group’s pictures are also deleted when the group is deleted or its last member leaves.
pp_s9_p1: You have the right to request access to your data, to request its rectification, erasure or the restriction of its processing, to receive your data in a portable format, to object to the processing, and to withdraw your consent (notifications, Google Calendar) at any time. We respond to your request within one month at the latest. You can lodge a complaint with the Hungarian National Authority for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (NAIH, naih.hu).
pp_s10_p1: The application is about alcoholic drinks, so it is intended only for users over 18. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has provided their data, write to the address above and we will delete it.
pp_s11_p1: Pictures uploaded to a group and the data entered there are visible only to members of that group. Until approval, a drink suggestion is visible only to the person who suggested it and their group mates. Group members can also see who uploaded a gallery picture (their name) in the application, on the Pictures page, below the picture.
pp_s11_p_hn: Your group members can also see your “Days since” counters: the counter’s name and the days passed, including on the group leaderboard. Until approval, the name of a counter template you suggest is visible only to you and the studio (superadmins); once approved, every user can pick it.
pp_s11_p2: On the Pictures page you can report any picture (for example for illegal or offensive content). The report is visible only to you and the studio members (superadmins), not to the uploader or other group members. For the investigation we make a copy of the reported picture that only the studio members (superadmins) can access; it is kept even if the picture is deleted in the meantime. We delete the copy once the investigation of the report is closed.
pp_s11_p3: Pictures uploaded to the gallery are cropped to the selected square, scaled down and compressed on your own device before upload, and all metadata of the picture (for example location/GPS, device model and time taken) is removed at that point; only the scaled-down picture reaches the server. Pictures are stored and shown only in a small size; we do not keep an original, full-size copy. Pictures can be seen only by members of the group concerned.
pp_s12_p1: The application does not use advertising or analytics cookies. localStorage is used only as a cache and to save the theme setting. The local copy of gallery pictures is kept in the browser cache (Cache Storage) so a picture does not have to be downloaded more than once; it is deleted when you sign out.
pp_s13_p1: We may update this statement from time to time. The date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.

tos_acc_p1: You sign in to the application with a Google account. Each person should use one account and must not hand it over to anyone else; you are responsible for actions taken with your account.
